BUREAU OF LEISURE NO. 0038
HOTEL DU COUVENT. OLD TOWN, NICE.
BUILT IN 1604 FOR THE ORDER OF SAINT CLARE.
A DECADE OF RESTORATION LED BY VALERY GREGO.
EIGHTY-EIGHT ROOMS. INTERIORS BY FESTEN.
ROMAN-STYLE BATHS. GARDENS OF 300 PLANT SPECIES.
BRING SOMEONE WHO HAS BEEN TO A BATHHOUSE AND LOVED IT.

alt_text: Hotel du Couvent, Old Town, Nice. A lime-plastered salon in a former convent, with linen sofas, a terracotta floor, paper globe lamps and an arched loggia onto the garden.
